subject: Pricing & competitor comparison — Crestware evaluation
messages:
From: Megan Liu <megan.liu@crestware.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-12T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Pricing & competitor comparison — Crestware evaluation

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — really appreciated the latency discussion and the KV cache examples. We're finalizing vendor pricing for a pilot and procurement has asked for a straightforward rate card and any public competitor comparisons you can share. Specifically: 

- Baseline hosted API generation pricing (per 1k tokens) and embeddings pricing (per embedding/query).
- Any published discounts for committed monthly spend (e.g., 3/6/12 month terms).
- A short note on features that matter to us: streaming, function calls, and enterprise SLA options.

We have price points from our other vendors (see attached spreadsheet) — can Redwood provide a baseline rate card and indicate whether you can come close to matching OpenAI/Anthropic/Together/AWS on unit economics with a committed spend?

Procurement also needs to understand SOC 2 and PO process if we move ahead.

Thanks,
Megan
Megan Liu
Director of AI Product
Crestware

Attachment: crestware_competitor_rates.xlsx (spreadsheet with publicly-sourced line items)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Megan Liu <megan.liu@crestware.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-13T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing & competitor comparison — Crestware evaluation

Hi Megan — great to hear and thanks for the spreadsheet. Looping in Marissa (AE) and Grace (Sales Ops) so we can get you a concise rate card and next steps on procurement.

Below is a clear baseline for our hosted API (public/standard rates) — we can follow up with a formal PDF rate card and a proposal: 

- Generation (hosted API, standard model family): $0.045 / 1k input+output tokens
- Embeddings (per vector): $0.004 per embedding (up to 1536-d)
- Streaming: included at the same token rate (no additional per-connection fee)
- Function calling / structured outputs: supported, no add-on charge

Committed spend discounts (typical ranges):
- 3-month: 10% off baseline
- 6-month: 15% off baseline
- 12-month: 20% off baseline + prioritized capacity routing

Key differentiators vs the vendors you noted:
- SLA and dedicated routing for committed customers (S3-level latency/availability targets available on Dedicated)
- Prefix/KV caching built-in to reduce per-token usage for chat-style workloads
- Flexible private deployment if you need VPC/on-prem for compliance

We can consider competitive matching on a case-by-case basis if you can commit to a minimum monthly spend. Quick questions to scope a matching offer:
1) Expected monthly token volume (tokens/month) for the pilot and for production scale?
2) Target latency SLO (p95 or p99) and peak concurrency?
3) Is there a strict procurement timeline or PO/contract window?

I've attached our concise rate card for reference (redwood-hosted-ratecard-May2026.pdf). If you can share the target committed spend, we will route to pricing and legal for a formal matching proposal.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-hosted-ratecard-May2026.pdf

From: Megan Liu <megan.liu@crestware.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@crestware.ai
Date: 2026-05-14T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing & competitor comparison — Crestware evaluation

Karthik — thanks for the quick summary. To be explicit, procurement is asking us to get vendor responses against these competitor price points we referenced (all public/pricing pages + our RFP submissions):

- OpenAI (gpt-4o-style public rate for generation): ~$0.03 / 1k tokens
- Anthropic (claude family): ~$0.045 / 1k tokens (varies by model)
- Together AI (lower-cost family): ~$0.025 / 1k tokens
- AWS Bedrock endpoints (some models): ~$0.08 / 1k tokens (higher list, deeper enterprise features)

Our ask: can Redwood match or get within ~10% of Together/OpenAI public per-token generation rate if we sign a 12-month committed spend? Crestware can commit to $75,000 / month for 12 months (annualized $900k) assuming SOC 2 evidence and standard PO/Net-30 terms. Embeddings pricing is also evaluated separately; our target for embeddings is <= $0.002 per vector at scale.

Procurement has also attached the questionnaire for legal/security review. Can you confirm timing on a commercial term sheet and an estimated time-to-sign?

Thanks,
Megan
Megan Liu
Director of AI Product
Crestware

Attachment: crestware_procurement_questionnaire.pdf

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Megan Liu <megan.liu@crestware.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-14T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing & competitor comparison — Crestware evaluation

Megan — really appreciate the clarity and the committed number. We've reviewed this with pricing and can provide a constructive offer that balances unit economics and capacity guarantees. High level commercial term (pilot -> production):

Offer (12-month committed spend):
- Committed Monthly Spend: $60,000 / month (12 months, $720k annual)
- Generation (hosted API) effective rate: $0.030 / 1k tokens (this is a blended, committed rate reflecting volume tiers + caching gains)
- Embeddings: $0.002 per embedding at scale (meets your target)
- Additional: 5% onboarding credit applied in month 1; prioritized capacity routing and a 99.9% availability SLA for Dedicated capacity (if elected)

Notes/conditions:
- This offer assumes a billed minimum of $60k/mo with true-up billing quarterly based on usage and minimum committed tiers.
- SOC 2 compliance evidence is available; legal will provide the artifact and standard security addenda.
- Standard Redwood MSA + SOW; procurement-friendly PO and Net-30 terms are acceptable once the MSA is executed.
- Full proposal + signature packet (DocuSign) attached: redwood-proposal-crestware-20260514.pdf

Next steps I recommend:
1) Procurement completes questionnaire (we'll assign Legal & Security to respond within 3 business days).
2) If the $60k/mo minimum is acceptable, we'll issue a formal commercial term sheet and DocuSign link for signature.
3) Work with Marissa on implementation timeline — we can aim for pilot onboarding within 2–3 weeks of signature.

If Crestware must hold to $75k/mo to hit internal targets, we can re-open to improve other terms (e.g., dedicated routing or additional credits). Happy to jump on a quick call to finalize.

Best regards,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-proposal-crestware-20260514.pdf
